body:
## Change

F1. Stop modal keydown propagation so Ctrl/Meta+Z on non-editable modal controls cannot invoke background deck undo. Preserve existing Tab/Escape handling and native input defaults.

## Validation

V1. Original bubbling-key regression failed before one-line fix. Parent reviewed helper/caller path, reran 9 focused/import/keyboard tests plus real Chromium production DeckEditor/YdkImport harness: focus entry/wrapping, Ctrl/Meta+Z isolation, typing, Escape/focus restoration and background undo after dismissal pass.
V2. Worker related: 34; contracts: 87; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed. Interrupted worker replaced for final validation; source unchanged during recovery.

## Limits

L1. Isolated component browser proof, not whole-app assets/persistence. Full CI has sampled acquisition-stage failures; no full-CI-green claim.
title: fix(deck-editor): isolate modal keys from background shortcuts
